observations: A mouth form at lower center shows a row of white rectangular tooth-shapes enclosed by layered red and orange loops; a dark gap is visible above the tooth row, suggesting the mouth is open.
Two nested-rectangle eye forms sit above the mouth — the left framed in magenta and green, the right in red and dark outlines — with zigzag and wave marks scattered between them.
Yellow vertical stripes on the left and a yellow horizontal bar on the right anchor the edges; loose scribbled marks in teal, white, and yellow-green extend into the black margins.
reading: A mouth with a visible dark gap above its tooth row and two nested-rectangle eyes hold a confrontational frontal arrangement. The black ground pushes the layered color outlines forward, making the face feel close and loud. Zigzag lines between the features read as agitation; the yellow bars at the edges hold the composition without softening it. The collector sees the nested loops as kin to scrimshaw's carved concentric lines.
contextAngle: Within the owned nnotb subset, title neighbors #255 and #257 differ sharply: #255 uses a pale warm field with a contained dark silhouette, and #257 opens into a flat purple space with two figures. Title order and recorded creation order align for these three works in the owned subset.
